description: Stable row identifier for the released candidate-pixel table
derivation: Sequential integer assigned after row-major extraction of retained pixels

description: Zero-based row index in the 1 km reference grid
derivation: Reference-raster row of the pixel center

description: Zero-based column index in the 1 km reference grid
derivation: Reference-raster column of the pixel center

description: Pixel-center easting in NAD83 / CONUS Albers
derivation: Computed from the reference-grid affine transform

description: Pixel-center northing in NAD83 / CONUS Albers
derivation: Computed from the reference-grid affine transform

description: First retained fire year for the pixel
derivation: Selected from the MTBS fire-year layer after candidate filtering

description: Fire severity class at the retained fire event
derivation: Sampled from the MTBS severity layer for t0; released codes range from 1 through 6

description: Indicator that the pixel met the retained forest mask at fire time
derivation: NLCD-by-t0 forest mask; released rows are all 1

description: Pre-fire RESI baseline
derivation: Mean of valid annual RESI values in the five years before fire

description: Immediate post-fire RESI minimum
derivation: Minimum annual RESI across the fire year and following year

temporal_window: t0 through t0+1 relative to pre-fire
description: Immediate resistance relative to baseline
derivation: Rmin divided by Bi

description: Time to recover to 50 percent of Bi
derivation: First post-fire offset reaching 0.50 times Bi; set to 10 when not reached

description: Whether the 50 percent recovery threshold was observed
derivation: One when any eligible post-fire RESI reaches 0.50 times Bi

description: Time to recover to 80 percent of Bi
derivation: First post-fire offset reaching 0.80 times Bi; set to 10 when not reached

description: Whether the 80 percent recovery threshold was observed
derivation: One when any eligible post-fire RESI reaches 0.80 times Bi

description: Time to recover to 90 percent of Bi
derivation: First post-fire offset reaching 0.90 times Bi; set to 10 when not reached

description: Whether the 90 percent recovery threshold was observed
derivation: One when any eligible post-fire RESI reaches 0.90 times Bi

description: Time to recover to 95 percent of Bi
derivation: First post-fire offset reaching 0.95 times Bi; set to 10 when not reached

description: Whether the 95 percent recovery threshold was observed
derivation: One when any eligible post-fire RESI reaches 0.95 times Bi

description: Integrated recovery deficit relative to the pre-fire baseline
derivation: clip(1 - observed ten-year RESI area / baseline area; 0; 1)

description: Integrated recovery index oriented so larger is better
derivation: clip(1 - IRI_gap; 0; 1)

description: Squared integrated recovery response used in the main analysis
derivation: IRI_good squared

description: Coefficient of variation of the interpolated post-fire RESI series
derivation: Standard deviation divided by mean of the nonnegative ten-year RESI segment

description: Stability transform of post-fire RESI variability
derivation: 1 divided by (1 + RESI_post_CV)

description: Stability index oriented so larger is better
derivation: STAB_CV clipped to [0; 1]

description: Squared post-fire stability response used in the main analysis
derivation: STAB_good squared

description: Cumulative RESI deficit relative to the pre-fire baseline
derivation: clip((baseline area - observed ten-year RESI area) / baseline area; 0; 1)

description: Mode existing-vegetation-type code at 1 km
derivation: Modal aggregation of LANDFIRE EVT 2022 to the project grid

description: Broad forest-type resistance proxy
derivation: Lookup from EVT group: nonwoody 0; shrub 1; deciduous 2; mixed 3; conifer 4 for retained tree/shrub classes

description: Broad forest-type regeneration proxy
derivation: Lookup from EVT group: nonwoody 0; shrub 4; deciduous 3; mixed 2; conifer 1 for retained tree/shrub classes

description: Broad vegetation group used by RF M2
derivation: Rule-based mapping of EVT metadata to nonwoody; shrub; deciduous; mixed; or conifer

description: Mean elevation at the 1 km pixel
derivation: Sampled from the 3DEP-derived project topography stack

description: Terrain slope at the 1 km pixel
derivation: Sampled from the 3DEP-derived project topography stack

description: North-facing component of aspect
derivation: Cosine of terrain aspect

description: East-facing component of aspect
derivation: Sine of terrain aspect

description: Topographic wetness index
derivation: Sampled from the 3DEP-derived project TWI layer

description: Local terrain roughness derived from elevation
derivation: Sampled from the 3DEP-derived project roughness layer

description: Soil organic carbon concentration proxy for 0–30 cm
derivation: 1 km aggregate of the SoilGrids 0–30 cm SOC proxy band; 15 released rows retain the source-stack -9999 nodata sentinel

description: GPW source year selected for each pixel
derivation: Nearest available GPW year to t0

description: Population-density pressure within the 10 km product window
derivation: Sampled from the project GPWv4 10 km-window population-density stack

description: VIIRS annual source year selected for each pixel
derivation: Nearest available VIIRS year to t0

description: Annual nighttime-light radiance near the fire year
derivation: Sampled from the nearest-year annual VIIRS nighttime-light layer

description: NLCD imperviousness source year selected for each pixel
derivation: Nearest available NLCD imperviousness year to t0

description: Impervious surface percentage near the fire year
derivation: Sampled from the nearest-year NLCD imperviousness layer

description: Pre-fire annual precipitation
derivation: Mean of three annual gridMET precipitation sums

description: Early post-fire annual precipitation
derivation: Mean of two annual gridMET precipitation sums

description: Pre-fire reference evapotranspiration
derivation: Mean of three annual gridMET ETo sums

description: Early post-fire reference evapotranspiration
derivation: Mean of two annual gridMET ETo sums

description: Pre-fire mean vapor-pressure deficit
derivation: Mean of three annual mean-VPD values

description: Early post-fire mean vapor-pressure deficit
derivation: Mean of two annual mean-VPD values

description: Pre-fire mean daily maximum temperature
derivation: Mean of three annual mean-maximum-temperature values

description: Early post-fire mean daily maximum temperature
derivation: Mean of two annual mean-maximum-temperature values

description: Pre-fire mean daily minimum temperature
derivation: Mean of three annual mean-minimum-temperature values

description: Early post-fire mean daily minimum temperature
derivation: Mean of two annual mean-minimum-temperature values

description: Pre-fire annual maximum of daily maximum temperature
derivation: Mean of three annual maximum-temperature values

description: Early post-fire annual maximum of daily maximum temperature
derivation: Mean of two annual maximum-temperature values

description: Pre-fire number of days above 30 C
derivation: Mean of three annual hot-day counts

description: Early post-fire number of days above 30 C
derivation: Mean of two annual hot-day counts

description: Pre-fire number of days above 35 C
derivation: Mean of three annual hot-day counts

description: Early post-fire number of days above 35 C
derivation: Mean of two annual hot-day counts

description: Pre-fire climatic water deficit
derivation: Mean of three annual values of ETo minus precipitation

description: Early post-fire climatic water deficit
derivation: Mean of two annual values of ETo minus precipitation

description: Pre-fire aridity ratio
derivation: Mean of three annual ETo-to-precipitation ratios

description: Early post-fire aridity ratio
derivation: Mean of two annual ETo-to-precipitation ratios

description: Pre-fire within-year variability of daily maximum temperature
derivation: Mean of three annual standard deviations of daily maximum temperature

description: Early post-fire within-year variability of daily maximum temperature
derivation: Mean of two annual standard deviations of daily maximum temperature

description: Pre-fire within-year variability of vapor-pressure deficit
derivation: Mean of three annual standard deviations of daily VPD

description: Early post-fire within-year variability of vapor-pressure deficit
derivation: Mean of two annual standard deviations of daily VPD

description: Static canopy base height at 1 km
derivation: Average-resampled LANDFIRE 2022 CBH; divide stored values by 10 for metres

description: Standardized static canopy base height
derivation: Full-table z-score of FS_CBH_1km

description: LANDFIRE CBH source year selected for each pixel
derivation: Nearest of 2008; 2010; 2012; 2014; 2016; or 2022 with earlier year winning ties

description: Fire-aligned canopy base height at 1 km
derivation: Average-resampled CBH from FS_CBH_t0agg_source_year; divide stored values by 10 for metres

description: Standardized fire-aligned canopy base height
derivation: Full-table z-score of FS_CBH_t0agg

description: Tree-canopy-cover source year selected for each pixel
derivation: Set equal to t0_year for annual 2000–2023 TCC

description: Tree canopy cover at the fire year
derivation: Mean aggregation of annual 30 m NLCD percent tree canopy cover to 1 km

description: Standardized fire-year tree canopy cover
derivation: Full-table z-score of FS_TCC_t0

description: Road density within a 5 km circular neighborhood
derivation: Exact OSM road-line length by 1 km cell; circular 5 km sum divided by circle area

description: Trail density within a 10 km circular neighborhood
derivation: Exact OSM trail-line length by 1 km cell; circular 10 km sum divided by circle area

description: Standardized 5 km road density
derivation: Full-table z-score of HUM_roaddens_r5km

description: Standardized 10 km trail density
derivation: Full-table z-score of HUM_traildens_r10km

description: Pixel-center longitude in WGS84
derivation: Coordinate transformation from EPSG:5070 to EPSG:4326

description: Pixel-center latitude in WGS84
derivation: Coordinate transformation from EPSG:5070 to EPSG:4326

description: Deterministic broad reporting region
derivation: Longitude/latitude rule in src/preprocessing/assign_reporting_regions.py
